title: A Debt for the Drop
author: Vesper Underhill
blurb: Freya Quintana, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
